integrations.title: Integrations (iOS Shortcuts)
integrations.hint: A token lets Shortcuts automations start and stop sleep and send Screen Time. It works only for those actions and acts like a password: never share it.
integrations.createdWarning: Copy it now: it will not be shown again.
integrations.revokeConfirm: Revoke the token “{{label}}”? Shortcuts using it will stop working.

integrations.usageHint: Step-by-step instructions are in shortcuts/README.md in the repository.
integrations.whatItDoes: Shortcuts are two iPhone commands: “Going to bed” starts your timer and “Woke up” stops it. Apple Health is not imported automatically.

steps.token: Create a token above and copy the whole value. It is shown only once. This is your SleepGuide key, not the Telegram bot token.
steps.new: Open Shortcuts → + → new shortcut. Name it “{{name}}”.
steps.url: Add the URL action with this address:
steps.request: Add Get Contents of URL. Expand its options and select the {{method}} method.
steps.header: In Headers add Authorization. Its value is Bearer, one space, then the full token you copied:
steps.body: Request Body: JSON with no fields ({}). Time is recorded when the shortcut runs.
steps.screenBody: Replace YYYY-MM-DD with the date, such as 2026-10-12. Request Body: JSON with numeric total_minutes and before_bed_minutes fields. This is manual entry, not automatic Screen Time access.
steps.test: Run the shortcut manually. The response should contain a record with an id, and SleepGuide should show a timer or completed sleep. For screen time, look for the date and minutes.

integrations.manualFirst: Test Going to bed and Woke up manually first. Then add them to your Home Screen or an automation. Scheduled runs record the execution time; they do not detect actual sleep.
integrations.troubleshoot: 401: check the token / create a new one. 403: the token cannot perform this action. no_open_session: run Going to bed first. wake_time_required: correct your wake-up time in SleepGuide.

data.title: Data stored
data.body:
Telegram ID, language, time zone, sleep preferences and reminder settings. Sleep times, workouts, stress ratings, screen-time records and personal insights. Integration metadata includes a label, prefix, token hash and use/revocation dates. Full tokens are not stored after creation. Exercise data includes names, weights, repetitions, distances and times. Records and streaks are calculated from history.
Optional morning restedness ratings and Sleep Score snapshots are used to evaluate the formula. Weekly targets and pattern reminder preferences are also stored.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.body: To maintain your history, calculate Sleep Score, find personal patterns and send enabled reminders. Insights are deterministic observations about your records, not a diagnosis or a proven cause. We also show exercise records and logging streaks.

sharing.title: Access and sharing
sharing.body:
Records are stored on the service owner’s server. Telegram provides sign-in and delivers bot messages; reminders and /wake responses may contain sleep duration or Score. Hosting providers and infrastructure administrators have technical access for their duties. The code contains no advertising trackers, third-party analytics or transmission of your records to an LLM.
OCR screenshots are processed locally on the device and are not uploaded to the server. PNG cards are generated locally; you choose the metrics and recipients.

retention.title: Retention and backups
retention.body: Records remain while you use the account or until you delete them. Account deletion clears the live database and token access. The project’s default backup rotation is 14 days; the owner must confirm the actual retention and off-server copies. After restoring an old backup, administrators must reapply deletion requests.

rights.title: Control over your data
rights.body: Settings lets you export all records as JSON, revoke tokens and delete your account with confirmation. Individual records can be edited and deleted in History. Contact the owner below with questions about data, access or backups.

security.title: Protection
security.body: The app uses HTTPS, verified Telegram sign-in and limited permissions for Shortcuts tokens. Only hashes of those tokens are stored. Exports contain personal data: keep them private and in a protected location.

contact.title: Owner and contact
contact.body: Before a public or beta release, the owner must identify themselves and provide a channel for privacy questions.

basis.title: Before release
basis.body: The owner must determine and describe the legal basis for processing, actual providers/storage regions and rules applicable to users. This draft is not yet a legally reviewed policy.

records.title: Exercise progress
records.hint: Records come from sets in completed workouts. Reps are compared at the same weight; time at the same distance.
records.empty: Use the Exercises button beside a completed workout to add exercises and results.
records.resultsHint: Add exercises and sets to this workout. Records update after finishing; each set can be edited separately.
records.name: Exercise name
records.kindHint: This measurement type applies to every result for this exercise. Create a separate exercise for a different movement.
records.bodyweight: For bodyweight exercises, enter 0 kg. Set volume = added weight × reps.
records.deleteLogConfirm: Delete this result? Records will be recalculated.
records.deleteExerciseConfirm: Delete “{{name}}” and all its results? Workouts will remain and records will be recalculated.
records.repeatHint: For example, 3 sets of 60 kg × 8. Add sets with different weights separately.
records.fairComparison: 60 kg × 12 and 80 kg × 6 are different results. Only sets at the same weight are compared here.
records.volumeExplanation: Set volume = weight × reps. This is not a lifted weight or a 1RM estimate.

streaks.title: Logging streaks
streaks.start: Each day with a log builds a fuller history.
streaks.todayOpen: Your streak continues. You still have today to add a log.
streaks.rules: Each day counts once, regardless of log count. Sleep counts completed main sleep on the wake-up date; workouts count completed sessions on the start date; stress and screen time use their recorded day. Yesterday’s streak stays active until today ends. This measures logging consistency and does not recommend daily training.

baselines.title: Your usual rhythm
baselines.hint: 7 completed days compared with the preceding 28. A difference needs 3 and 14 observed days.
baselines.note: A description of your records, not a cause of change. Missing observations stay missing. Workouts count logged days; the baseline is scaled to a week.

goals.title: Weekly goals
goals.hint: Days with records, Monday through Sunday. 0 disables a goal. The sleep goal is for keeping a diary, not reaching a score.
goals.settings: Change targets in Settings. Each day counts once.

awards.title: Achievements
awards.hint: Achievements reflect current history. Deleting records can change progress. Rest days do not reset accumulated progress.

feedback.title: How rested did you feel on waking?
feedback.hint: Rate this particular morning. Optional feedback helps evaluate Sleep Score; workouts do not affect it.
feedback.scale: 1 — not rested at all, 5 — well rested.

reminder.title: Follow my rhythm
reminder.hint: 30 minutes before your median bedtime: at least 14 nights in the preceding 28 days with a spread of at most 60 minutes. Naps are excluded.
reminder.collecting: No stable pattern yet. The fallback time is used if enabled.

calibration.title: Sleep Score evaluation
calibration.excluded: Excluded: {{stale}} after history/goal changes, {{limited}} with limited data.
calibration.hint: Version {{version}}. Last 180 days: at least 28 nights, 3 restedness levels and a Score spread of 5 points. Correlation describes association, not causation. Formula weights remain unchanged until calibration is validated using real data.

transfer.otherHint: Download a template for this data type. Times use your profile time zone; workout CSV dates mean the completion day. Export includes all completed entries.

transfer.noOverwrite: Duplicates are skipped. Existing entries are never overwritten.
